en.title: Muddy Water, Old Books, and Roaring Steam
en.premise: A scavenger just trying to make a living stumbles upon a miraculously preserved "used bookstore" deep underground. Inside lie technical manuals from a lost era, including instructions to restart the massive steam pump that is the city's only hope. Hunted by greedy armed factions, she clutches a single weathered manual and races through the labyrinth of rusted iron.

zh.title: 泥水、旧书与轰鸣的蒸汽
zh.premise: 为了糊口而在底层四处搜寻废品的“我”，某天在地下深处发现了一家奇迹般完好保存的“旧书店”。那里沉睡着失落时代的科技书籍，并记载着拯救这座城市的唯一手段——重启巨型蒸汽泵的方法。在贪婪武装集团的追捕下，我怀揣着一本泛黄的手册，在生锈的钢铁迷宫中奔逃。
